            '      builder: (context) => Text(\n'

            '        key: const Key(\'paywall_backup_line\'),\n'
            '        style: ArchiveMobileTypography.responsiveHelper(context),\n'
            '        textAlign: TextAlign.center,\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'

            '\n'
            '  Widget _generalConversionClaritySection({required bool includeBullets}) {\n'
            '    return Column(\n'
            '      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,\n'
            '      children: [\n'
            '        _paywallPositioningLine(),\n'
            '        const SizedBox(height: 8),\n'

            '          includeTrustLine: !_showsPurchaseConfidenceCard,\n'

            '        const SizedBox(height: 10),\n'

            '      ],\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  bool get _billingReady =>\n'
            '      widget.billingReadyOverride?.call() ??\n'
            '      RevenueCatService.instance.isConfigured;\n'
            '\n'
            '  bool get _restoreBillingReady =>\n'
            '      widget.billingConfiguredForRestore?.call() ?? _billingReady;\n'
            '\n'
            '  bool get _purchasePlansAvailable => _ps.purchasePlansAvailable;\n'
            '\n'
            '  /// Source-aware copy variant, when the opener passed a [PaywallSource].\n'
            '  PaywallSourceCopy? get _sourceCopy {\n'
            '    final source = widget.triggerArgs?.source;\n'
            '    return source == null ? null : PaywallSourceCopy.forSource(source);\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  PaywallSource get _attributionSource =>\n'
            '      widget.triggerArgs?.source ?? PaywallSource.generalPro;\n'
            '\n'
            '  PaywallAttributionStore? get _attribution =>\n'
            '      widget.attributionStore ??\n'
            '      (AppServices.isInitialized ? PaywallAttributionStore.instance() : null);\n'
            '\n'
            '  /// True when this paywall was opened from a daily suggestion surface.\n'
            '  bool get _fromSuggestion =>\n'
            '      _attributionSource == PaywallSource.dailySuggestion ||\n'
            '      _attributionSource == PaywallSource.startHereToday;\n'
            '\n'
            '  SuggestionAttributionStore? get _suggestionAttribution =>\n'
            '      widget.suggestionAttributionStore ??\n'
            '      (AppServices.isInitialized\n'
            '          ? SuggestionAttributionStore.instance()\n'
            '          : null);\n'
            '\n'
            '  /// Fire-and-forget local attribution write; no-op when services are absent.\n'
            '  /// Suggestion-sourced opens also log the suggestion-to-Pro funnel stage.\n'
            '  void _recordAttribution(\n'
            '    PaywallAttributionEventType type, {\n'
            '    SuggestionAttributionEventType? suggestionStage,\n'
            '  }) {\n'
            '    // Purchase stages also feed the product funnel — source id only, never\n'
            '    // user content. paywall_seen already reaches analytics via First25.\n'
            '    if (type == PaywallAttributionEventType.purchaseStarted ||\n'
            '        type == PaywallAttributionEventType.purchaseCompleted) {\n'
            '      ActivationFunnelAnalytics.track(type.id, source: _attributionSource.id);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    // Invited funnel mirror — additive, attribution-gated, carrying only\n'
            '    // the invite source (never the paywall source or any URL).\n'
            '    switch (type) {\n'
            '      case PaywallAttributionEventType.paywallSeen:\n'
            '        InviteFunnelMetrics.paywallSeen();\n'
            '      case PaywallAttributionEventType.purchaseStarted:\n'
            '        InviteFunnelMetrics.purchaseStarted();\n'
            '      case PaywallAttributionEventType.purchaseCompleted:\n'
            '        InviteFunnelMetrics.purchaseCompleted();\n'
            '      default:\n'
            '        break;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final store = _attribution;\n'
            '    if (store != null) {\n'
            '      unawaited(\n'
            '        store.record(\n'
            '          type,\n'
            '          source: _attributionSource,\n'
            '          sourceRoute: widget.triggerArgs?.sourceRoute,\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (suggestionStage == null || !_fromSuggestion) return;\n'
            '    final suggestionStore = _suggestionAttribution;\n'
            '    if (suggestionStore == null) return;\n'
            '    unawaited(suggestionStore.record(suggestionStage));\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  ProPackagingDisplay get _packaging => ProPackagingEngine.build(\n'
            '    offeringsAvailable: _purchasePlansAvailable,\n'
            '    showPlanPrices: _purchasePlansAvailable,\n'
            '  );\n'
            '\n'
            '  String get _unavailableBodyText {\n'
            '    if (!_billingReady) {\n'
            '      return \'${ConsumerUiCopy.paywallSetupUnavailableBody}\\n\\n\'\n'

            '    final err = _ps.errorMessage;\n'
            '    if (err == SubscriptionCopy.paywallNoOfferings ||\n'
            '        err == SubscriptionCopy.temporarilyUnavailable) {\n'
            '      return \'${ConsumerUiCopy.paywallSetupUnavailableBody}\\n\\n\'\n'
            '          \'${ConsumerUiCopy.paywallUnavailablePlansLoading}\';\n'
            '    }\n'

            '\n'
            '  bool _passesDelayedPaywallProofGate() {\n'

            '    return DelayedPaywallProofStore.passesGate;\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _resolveDelayedPaywallGate() async {\n'
            '    if (widget.delayedPaywallProofGateOverride == null &&\n'
            '        !ScreenshotMode.enabled &&\n'
            '        !DelayedPaywallProofStore.isGateBypassedForTesting) {\n'

            '    _paywallSeenTracked = true;\n'
            '    RevenueFunnelAnalytics.paywallSeen(\n'
            '      source: _attributionSource.id,\n'
            '      isPro: entitlements.isPro,\n'

            '    PaywallValueSharpeningAnalytics.seen(\n'

            '      surface: \'paywall_screen\',\n'
            '      proofConnected: PaywallValueSharpeningCopy.isProofConnectedSource(\n'
            '        _attributionSource,\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    ActivationTracker.trackPaywallShown();\n'
            '    final preview = widget.triggerArgs?.valuePreview;\n'
            '    if (preview != null) {\n'
            '      ActivationTracker.trackProValuePreviewShown(preview.typeId);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    unawaited(First25UserMetrics.trackPaywallSeen(surface: \'paywall_screen\'));\n'

            '    );\n'

            '      RevenueLiftExperimentV2Analytics.paywallSeen(\n'
            '        context: RevenueLiftExperimentV2PaywallSeenContext(\n'
            '          source: _attributionSource.id,\n'
            '          surface: \'paywall_screen\',\n'
            '          entryCount: 0,\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'

            '    final yearly = _ps.packageFor(PaywallPlan.yearly);\n'
            '    if (yearly != null) ActivationTracker.trackAnnualPlanShown();\n'
            '    if (monthly != null) ActivationTracker.trackMonthlyPlanShown();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _trackPlanSelected(PaywallPlan plan) {\n'
            '    if (plan == PaywallPlan.yearly) {\n'
            '      ActivationTracker.trackAnnualPlanSelected();\n'
            '    } else {\n'
            '      ActivationTracker.trackMonthlyPlanSelected();\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  /// Stable plan id for analytics — never user text.\n'
            '  String _planIdFor(PaywallPlan plan) => plan == PaywallPlan.yearly\n'
            '      ? PaywallPlanSelectionConfidence.yearlyPlanId\n'
            '      : PaywallPlanSelectionConfidence.monthlyPlanId;\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _continue() async {\n'
            '    _purchaseAttemptedThisSession = true;\n'
            '    _recordAttribution(\n'
            '      PaywallAttributionEventType.purchaseStarted,\n'
            '      suggestionStage:\n'
            '          SuggestionAttributionEventType.suggestionToPurchaseStarted,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    final package = _ps.packageFor(_ps.selectedPlan);\n'
            '    if (package == null) {\n'
            '      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(\n'
            '        const SnackBar(content: Text(SubscriptionCopy.paywallNoOfferings)),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    setState(() {});\n'
            '\n'
            '    RevenueFunnelAnalytics.paywallPurchaseCtaTapped(\n'
            '      source: _attributionSource.id,\n'
            '      isPro: _ps.entitlements?.isPro == true,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    ActivationTracker.trackPaywallContinueTapped();\n'
            '    // Purchase intent: remember the start (stable ids only) and suppress\n'
            '    // the return cue for the rest of this session — cancelling the App\n'
            '    // Store sheet never triggers an immediate nudge.\n'
            '    PurchaseIntentReturnCue.purchaseStartedThisSession = true;\n'
            '    unawaited(\n'
